name: Zafran Hair Growth Therapy Oil - 150ml
description:
ACTIWOW Zafran Hair Oil – Hair Growth Therapy Saffron Oil 150g

Promote healthier, stronger, and fuller hair with ACTIWOW Zafran Hair Oil, enriched with the natural goodness of saffron and sesame oil for complete hair nourishment.

Key Benefits:

Hair Growth Therapy: Stimulates hair follicles to support growth and reduce hair fall.

Nourishes & Strengthens: Deeply conditions hair, improving texture, shine, and manageability.

Organic & Natural: Made with high-quality organic ingredients suitable for all hair types.

Versatile Use: Ideal for men and women; can also be used for beard care and styling.

Hair Type: All hair types
Quantity: 150g | Container Type: Bottle
Trend Uses: Beard oil, man bun care, perfect hair maintenance, and kept beard styling.

Perfect for daily hair and beard care, promoting growth, shine, and healthy scalp.
